workflow_runs.display_title: fix(tests): notifier desktop-command scratch needs tmp/ parent (CI-only failure)

head_commit.message:
fix(tests): notifier desktop-command scratch needs tmp/ parent (CI-only failure)

test-campaign-notifier's desktop-command sink writes to
tmp/notify-desktop-test.out via `echo >>`. tmp/ is gitignored and
absent in fresh CI checkouts, so the shell exits 2 and the assertion
fails 9/1. Local runs masked it because the repo-local tmp/ exists.
Ensure the parent dir exists (make-directory* "tmp") before firing
the sink. Verified: 10/10 in a fresh worktree (previously 9/1),
matching the release-run failure exactly.

workflow_runs.display_title: fix(provider-retry): BUG-0022 — health gate no longer truncates same-turn retries to 2/5

head_commit.message:
fix(provider-retry): BUG-0022 — health gate no longer truncates same-turn retries to 2/5

The provider health gate (window 60s, threshold 3) recorded every retry
failure, so a fast-repeating error tripped the 3/60s threshold after
exactly 2 same-turn retries (min(max-retries, threshold-1)) — the
'[SYS] [retry: attempt 2/5]' → 'after 2 retries' truncation symptom.

Fix: only the turn-INITIAL failure (attempt 0) feeds the health window.
Same-turn retries stay bounded by max-retries, per-type budgets, the
cumulative ceiling, and the held/stall/silent-overflow breakers.
Cross-turn protection is preserved: a genuinely sick provider still
trips the gate on the next turn's initial failure.

Gate denials now surface visibly: provider.health-gate trace gains the
'attempt field, and a circuit-breaker retry event is emitted so the TUI
transcript explains the early stop (generic wording in tool-events).

Tests:
- new tests/test-bug-0022-health-gate-truncation.rkt (2/2): full 5-retry
  budget within a turn; cross-turn gate denial still works
- characterization pin flipped 2 -> 5 (test-gsd-executor-retry-*)
- model-switch e2e + session error correlation recalibrated to the
  full budget (fail-times 6 > 1+5)
- test-test-lint: subprocess-wait before reading exit status (flake fix)
- fast suite: 1141 pass, 0 fail (delivery-verifier 2m timeout is a
  pre-existing per-file-limit issue, passes solo in 2m15s)

workflow_runs.display_title: fix(gsd): BUG-0037 W2 — hook dropped tool arguments; all bash calls collapsed into one signature

head_commit.message:
fix(gsd): BUG-0037 W2 — real root cause: hook dropped tool arguments, collapsing all bash calls into one signature

Fourth live false-kill exposed the actual defect. The watchdog never
saw arguments at all:

* step-executor.rkt built the post-tool-result hook messages with only
  'content and 'name. The stall signature (name + arguments hash) thus
  degenerated to "bash|" for EVERY bash call — each kill fired at
  exactly the hard limit with 'repeating bash', whatever the limit was
  (3, then 8, then 15). Threshold tuning was treating symptoms.
* wave-executor.rkt additionally truncated argument values at 64 chars,
  collapsing distinct long commands sharing the cd-prefix.

Fix:
* step-executor now carries 'arguments (from tool-call-arguments) in
  hook messages.
* Signature digest is full-fidelity: canonicalized ~s of the complete
  argument set; string-form arguments (provider JSON-parse fallback)
  hash by content; missing arguments keep the documented degenerate
  "" digest (defensive: identical-looking calls still steer/kill).
* New LIVE REGRESSION tests: 25 distinct commands sharing a cd-prefix
  never trip; 20 distinct string-form arguments never trip; missing-
  arguments repeats pin the defensive contract.

Fast suite 1141/1141 green.

head_commit.message:
fix(gsd): BUG-0037 follow-up — raise repetition limits; stall deaths classify as retryable

Live campaign evidence (v1.00.20 W2 attempt 1, killed 4 calls in):

* Thresholds: soft 2→5, hard 3→8, window 10→20. A true livelock repeats
  dozens of times; legitimate re-runs of the same grep/test between other
  work stay far below the kill line. Regression tests pin interleaved
  repetition (6 identical greps + reads + test runs) as never-killed.

* Retry classification: the executor session's tool loop converts the
  gsd-stall-exn into a loop-result 'error carrying the stall message, so
  the gsd-stall-exn? handlers at the runner boundary never fired and the
  death stopped the campaign. prompt-run-result->outcome now recognizes
  the canonical 'mutation-stall watchdog:' prefix and routes it to the
  retryable 'infra-failed path (bounded auto-resume with prior context).

load flake).

head_commit.message:
fix(gsd): BUG-0037 W1 — repetition-based mutation-stall watchdog v2

Stall = repetition within a recent window, not mere absence of mutation.

* wave-executor: tool-call signature (name + normalized args hash);
  sliding window (10); soft steer at 2 identical, hard kill at 3;
  absolute backstop (200) for signature-cycling livelocks with INFO log
  at 75%; mutation resets counter AND clears the window; snapshot
  carries stall-reason/stall-tool/recent-tools.
* go-orchestrator: observe-hook records now carry 'arguments (without
  them every read collapsed to one signature); gsd-stall-exn maps to
  RETRYABLE 'infra-failed outcome at both conversion sites so watchdog
  deaths auto-resume with prior-attempt context instead of halting the
  campaign; hard-failure message names looped tool + recent tools.
* tests: characterization pins flipped to v2 regression suite; legacy
  watchdog suite rewritten to v2 semantics (70 distinct reads never
  trip; identical triple kills; backstop; inert opt-outs).

Fast suite 1141/1141 green. Fixes BUG-0037.
